design_direction.rationale: People choosing a dentist want reassurance of competence and comfort before anything else, and with strong ratings (4.7/4.6) and warm patient reviews already in hand, leading with those facts builds trust faster than photos of a waiting room. A warm, teal-accented feel signals calm and cleanliness rather than the cold-clinical or corporate look many dental sites default to; 'Menu' has no real content here (only 'Special') so it's suppressed to avoid an embarrassing empty section.

blocks.heading: Dr. Garry Phillips
blocks.text: We know that going to the dentist can be difficult sometimes, so we do everything we can to make sure you’re relaxed and comfortable – whether you’re coming in for a routine exam, emergency dentistry , or Invisalign . Our first priority is to treat you as we want to be treated: with respect, patience and clarity. Give Us a Call Our Services In Proud Association

blocks.heading: Dental Insurance Accepted
blocks.text: Trying to find a new dentist in Frisco with your new insurance? Call us so we can help! Don’t have insurance? That’s not a problem! We have a great in-office payment plan to get you started! Schedule an Appointment

blocks.heading: Our Dental Services
blocks.text: See All Our Services Family Dentistry Where your family’s health is our priority! From regular cleanings to full mouth rehabilitation, our services will be available to you. Invisalign Invisalign is a comfortable alternative to wire braces. So, you can get the smile you’ve always dreamed of at our nearby office! Dental Crowns A crown provides the functionality of a healthy tooth while the damaged one is given time to heal and repair itself. Cosmetic Dentistry At Frisco Dental Care, we’re dedicated to ensuring that you achieve your smile goals by offering you various cosmetic dentistry solutions. Implants A dental implant is a prosthesis that connects with the bone of the jaw to support a crown, bridge, or denture. Limited Time Special $500 OFF Invisalign Services Call Us to Learn More

blocks.heading: Our Services
blocks.text: We provide a wide range of professional dental services in Frisco to meet your needs. We promise to provide every service with a smile, and to the highest level of satisfaction. Become A Patient Invisalign → Cosmetic Dentistry → Dental Crowns → Family Dentistry → Implants →

blocks.heading: Invisalign
blocks.text: Want a straight smile that shows your inner confidence without traditional metal braces? Introducing Invisalign, the clear way to get the smile you’ve always wanted. Invisalign works by adjusting the teeth using applied pressure. But unlike braces, you don’t have to give up on popcorn, candy, gum, or any of your favorite foods. Invisalign is also more comfortable when compared to traditional braces. There are no wires that have to be adjusted or other annoyances. Instead, you’ll have to wear thin, transparent aligners that gently adjust crowded and crooked teeth. Invisalign aligners are made out of durable, medical-grade plastic. The aligners are almost undetectable and can be popped in and out easily. This virtually eliminates any interference to your daily life, whether you’re at work or at home. blocks.heading: Cosmetic Dentistry
blocks.text: Our cosmetic dentistry solutions are world-class, and hundreds of patients trust them and rely on us for their dental needs. With Dr. Philips' unique skills and long experience, we can provide customized and ideal solutions for most aesthetic dental issues. Learn More

blocks.heading: Dental Crowns
blocks.text: A dental crown is a good treatment for a damaged tooth. Besides helping restore your smile, the crowns also assist in restoring a tooth that would be otherwise be extracted. Dentists recommend crowns because they have multiple benefits. Learn More

blocks.heading: Family Dentistry
blocks.text: At Frisco Dental Care, we are your one-stop shop for all your family's dental care needs. We attend to patients of all age groups, from infants to seniors. And unlike other facilities that will treat you as just a number, we consider each of our clients as a unique case because we understand that each person's condition is exceptional. Learn More

blocks.heading: Dental Implants
blocks.text: A dental implant is a prosthesis that connects with the bone of the jaw to support a crown, bridge, or denture. Learn More

testimonials.author: J M (Texas Foodie)
testimonials.text: Great dentist office.  Dr Phillips is very gentle and comforting.   I had a crown refitted and a teeth cleaning.   Everyone in the office is friendly and knowledgeable.

testimonials.author: Mike
testimonials.text: This office is top notch. Not only are the friendly, they provide great service, reasonable prices and only recommend services required. They also are willing to work with patients that need to reschedule. If you're looking for a great dentist. This is the place to go

testimonials.author: Shawn Owen
testimonials.text: They were right on time, explained the process /costs, performed the work and had me on the road in 20 minutes. My teeth look great, can’t tell where they were repaired!

testimonials.author: Laurie Dennis
testimonials.text: I broke a tooth, googled for a close dentist that had good reviews. That led me to Frisco Dental Care. They got me in the next day. I would absolutely recommend them to anyone needing a dentist! Every single one in there, from the front desk all the way to the Dr. were so kind and so helpful and instantly made me feel comfortable knowing I made the right choice in Dentists. Highly recommend!!

testimonials.author: Steve Marinelli
testimonials.text: I have been a patient of Dr. Phillips for at least 25 years.  He is a good dentist who listens well and takes time to explain. Very happy with him.  And Roxanne has been cleaning my teeth for several years and is always careful and gentle.  I recommend his office.
